cases.input: Runs R1 and R2 use the same approved recipe revision with different datasets and resolved configurations.
cases.expect: The recipe is shared while R1 and R2 remain distinct runs with separate lineage, rights, configuration digests and outcomes.

cases.input: A run checkpoint is selected and promoted into a release artifact.
cases.expect: Promotion creates a WM-SFT-004 artifact revision linked to the checkpoint; selection, release and deployment remain separate.

cases.input: Two runs draw from one external compute reservation and report different observed GPU-hours.
cases.expect: The grant, each run request and WM-FLW-015 actuals remain distinct and unused capacity is not inferred as consumption.

cases.input: A reusable recipe and each execution share one identifier and lifecycle.
cases.expect: The merge is rejected because reusable specification and execution occurrence have independent identity and lifecycle.

cases.input: An artifact digest is used as the sole business identity for model, artifact and registry entry.
cases.expect: The merge is rejected; digest verifies bytes while governed identities remain distinct.

cases.input: A run claims reproducibility because it records one random seed but omits software and hardware pins.
cases.expect: The claim is rejected as unbounded and under-specified.

cases.input: Artifacts trained under different dataset restrictions are served by one endpoint and their restrictions are collapsed.
cases.expect: The collapse is rejected; shared serving never merges lineage or relaxes rights.
